# Write-free residual: generate pure-path refusals never mutate the filesystem.
# Full generate e2e (successful commit) lives under j8h.2; this script only
# proves invalid inputs fail before staging (REQ-003/033 pure pipeline gate).

# Snapshot sentinel before generate.
snapshot_tree sentinel before.txt

# Basename must equal project name — pure pipeline exit 2, no stage/dest.
! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./sentinel/wrong-name
stderr 'spec.invalid_field|destination'
! exists sentinel/wrong-name
assert_tree_unchanged sentinel before.txt

# JSON form: failure envelope on stdout, empty stderr.
! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./sentinel/wrong-name --output json
stdout 'spec.invalid_field|destination'
stdout '"ok":false'
! stderr .
! exists sentinel/wrong-name

# Bad verify fails as usage before any FS work.
! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify none
stderr 'usage.invalid'
assert_error_id stderr usage.invalid

# Missing required --spec.
! exec foundry generate
stderr 'usage.invalid|required'

# After all generate attempts, sentinel still pure.
assert_tree_unchanged sentinel before.txt
list_tree sentinel
